faq.howAddEmployeesAnswer: Go to Settings > Users. Click 'Add user', enter email and role (Manager or Employee). An invitation will be sent to their email.
faq.howSwitchStatusAnswer: Use the toggle in the left sidebar. Each status has its own set of features and navigation adapted to your tasks.
faq.howCreateRequest: How to create a purchase request?
faq.howCreateRequestAnswer: Go to the Catalog, select the products you need and click 'Add to request'. Or import a list from Excel via the 'Excel Import' section. Smart Match will automatically find matches in the catalog.
faq.excelFormatsAnswer: Files in .xlsx and .xls formats are supported. The table must contain columns: Name, SKU (or GOST), Quantity, Unit of Measure. XLSX is recommended for best compatibility.
faq.whatIsSmartMatchAnswer: Smart Match is an automatic matching algorithm for Excel items against the catalog. It searches by SKU, GOST, name and equipment group, returning results: Found, Partial, Not Found.
faq.howLandedCostAnswer: FCA Base Price + DAP Logistics (8%) + Customs Duty (5%) = Landed Cost. Then: Landed Cost x (1 + Margin%) = Price excl. VAT x 1.12 = Total incl. VAT (12% Uzbekistan).
faq.canEditSentQuote: Can I edit a sent quote?
faq.canEditSentQuoteAnswer: Yes, but this will create a new version (v2, v3...). Old versions are kept in the archive for audit. The client will see the latest version.
faq.howRequestDiscountAnswer: When viewing a quote, click 'Request discount', enter the desired percentage and comment. The seller will receive a notification and can recalculate the quote.
faq.whatRolesAnswer: Administrator — full access and management. Manager — business operations: deals, procurement, quotes. Employee — limited view.
faq.howResetPasswordAnswer: Click 'Forgot password?' on the login page. A recovery link will be sent to your registered email.

nomenclature.title: Nomenclature
nomenclature.subtitle: Your product cards: candidates from requests and the published catalog
nomenclature.publishFailed: Could not publish — check the required fields

emptyHint.DRAFT: Candidates appear on their own: when you send a quote with items that are not in the catalog, they land here together with what you filled in — part number, standard, HS code.
emptyHint.PUBLISHED: Published cards take part in matching: the next request with the same item fills in automatically.

nomenclature.whyBody: Every published card removes manual typing from future quotes: the system fills in the part number, unit and HS code by itself.

reclass.title: Need reclassification: {{count}}
reclass.hint: The HS classifier was updated and these codes were retired. New quotes must not inherit them — pick current ones.

classify.title: HS code suggestions: {{count}}
classify.hint: The AI picked codes FROM the classifier. Review and apply — cards change only after your confirmation.

duplicates.title: Possible duplicates ({{count}})
duplicates.hint: An exact key matches: brand + part number, GOST/drawing or name. The duplicate is archived; demand and references move to the surviving card.
duplicates.confirmBody: “{{duplicate}}” will be merged into “{{survivor}}” and archived. Empty fields are filled in, demand adds up, offers and quote lines move over.

nomenclature.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, GOST or SKU

nomenclature.noMatchesHint: Try another query or clear the filters — the item may be on another page.

hsDirectory.empty: The classifier is empty — the next auto-sync will fill it

ai.title: AI lookup
ai.hint: Describe the product in your own words — the AI picks a code FROM the classifier and explains the choice. An invented code is impossible: the pick is verified against the classifier.
ai.placeholder: e.g.: a rubber pad that goes under a rail fastening…
ai.failed: Could not get an answer — try again
ai.nothing: No matching code found — check the nearest branches:
ai.minLength: Describe the product in at least {{count}} characters

categories.hint: The category tree is maintained by the platform: it is shared by every seller — clients browse by it and HS codes are matched against it.

products.subtitle: Catalog items: {{total}}

products.emptyHint: Create a product card or set this classification on an existing one.

request.description: Categories are created by the platform, so clients find goods the same way across sellers. Describe the one you need: an operator will review the request. It does not block your work on product cards.

request.success: Request sent — an operator will review it

emptyHint.DRAFTS: Create a card manually or upload a price list — drafts become publishable once required fields are filled.
emptyHint.ARCHIVED: Cards removed from the storefront or merged as duplicates end up here. Any of them can be restored.

dealMargin.title: Deal margin: quote vs actual purchase
dealMargin.description: Compared with quote v{{version}} ({{number}}). The client price is not recalculated — only the margin changes.
dealMargin.noActuals: No actual purchase entered yet — showing the quoted margin.
dealMargin.footnote: Cost is the supplier price plus duty, in UZS; revenue is the quote lines excl. VAT. Actual purchases are entered by finance or purchasing.
dealMargin.amountInvalid: The amount must be zero or more with up to 2 decimals
dealMargin.rateHelp: Central bank {{rate}} on {{date}}. Empty — the table rate on the purchase date.
dealMargin.rateHelpNoRate: Empty — the table rate on the purchase date.
